thread:
anya: Hi all, first-day struggle 6a84bb My M2 MacBook booted but Kandji shows 'Not enrolled'. FileVault didn't ask to enable and homebrew installs fail with permission denied. Anyone know if ABM migration could cause this?

lucas: welcome @anya! quick question: did you sign in with Okta SSO during initial setup? if not ABM/profile won't attach. Can you run `profiles status` and `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial`?

anya: signed into Okta during OOBE. serial: C02ZJ0ABC3CD
profiles status: No enrolled MDM profile found.

it-bot: Support ticket created INC-2390 and assigned to emily-it. https://internal.redwood/support/INC-2390

emily-it: hey @anya, holding ticket. Two paths: 1) re-assign device in ABM/Kandji and push enrollment, or 2) one-time local admin so you can install tooling. which do you prefer?

anya: prefer fixing ABM if it's quick, but need to do some dev setup now.

devex-dave: i can grant a 1-hour admin session. please file the devex admin form: https://internal.redwood/devex/admin-request and post the id here.

emily-it: i'm checking ABM now. during the tenant cutover some serials didn't move to the new Kandji server. if i manually assign the device to the new MDM group you'll get the profile on next boot.

anya: submitted admin form id ADM-7905

emily-it: assigned serial in Kandji and triggered an enrollment push. reboot and run `profiles status` please.

lucas: note for handbook: ABM reassign is a common pitfall after migration. we'll add a step to imaging checklist.

anya: after reboot, profiles status shows "MDM: Kandji (managed)". FileVault prompt appeared on login; recovery key saved to company escrow. Homebrew install now works. :tada:

emily-it: closing INC-2390. devex-dave, your admin grant for ADM-7905 should be active; can you revoke early if not needed?

devex-dave: grant used 10m and revoked. leaving a note in the onboarding doc about checking ABM assignment before giving admin.

anya: huge thanks everyone, that unblocked my setup. adding this thread to onboarding notes for the next new hire.
